hi, guys:

notes.title: Daily Update
notes.notes:
Daily Update:

UI:
Help button will not always flashing.

Localization:
Fix some translation error.

Balance:
1. Remove all requirements of product property when they hand in the nation.

2. Decrease the currency earned after providing products to nation. 100% -> 10%

3. Increase Initial currency. 2000 -> 3000

Graphic:

1. Improved expressiveness and performance when bombing.

notes.title: Progress of next update
notes.notes:
Hello everyone:

All devs are preparing for next update several months. We plan to update "Design Blueprint, production data and Technology tree" , "Fight: enemy bombing" later this month or early next month.

notes.title: Update patch log (2018/7/5)
notes.notes:
Hello everyone:

The patch will be updated in a few hours...

Because of player desire, we will update  as soon as possible.

Patch log:
1. Added 'Historical date'. To prepare for the new game mission system.

2. Added 'AutoSave'. Ensure game progress safety.

3. Added two options: 'Resolution' and 'WindowMode'. It will fix bug: mouse click incorrect postion. We have filtered suitable resolutions, according to ur device.

ps: DO NOT try to modify the ini files in game folder. using a game resolution higher than desktop resolution, MAY casue 'mouse click incorrect postion' BUG.

pps: New patch will cause the old game save invalid.
